current_bottleneck: The best IV-only stress prototype, 510a, is not fully presentable because it misses regime under-inclusion and cannot generate factor-coherent scenarios. Local non-IV factor histories contain material future stress signal, so IV-only wrappers are the wrong next focus.
last_result_summary: 553a audited local non-IV factor history signal over the official validation framing. Best factor-history absolute Spearman was 0.799 versus 0.576 for IV-only history; price, levels, slopes, skews, and return history all carried material signal for future IV level or return stress.
next_step_recommendation: Build a factor-conditioned or joint IV+factor scenario generator. Keep 510a as the current IV-only prototype core, but the next model should condition on observed return/price/level/slope/skew history and eventually generate factor-consistent paths.
current_best_note: Both score 8/11 and fail coverage, regime_coverage, and distributional_fidelity. 510a improves coverage geometry and path KS but keeps level KS 10/25 and regime layer2 0/8 while thinning conditionality/cointegration margins.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
